nodes.label: Pre-warm zone / uncull budget pattern
nodes.rationale: Slices spend ~SAFETY_FRAMES frames in the off-screen warm zone before entering the viewport, spreading cacheAsTexture rebakes across multiple frames to avoid per-frame spikes during fast pans. MAX_PRE_PAD caps the zone so the full world is not kept visible during very fast panning.

nodes.label: targetId field (open/closed loop switch)
nodes.rationale: When targetId is non-null the brain runs closed-loop control resolving setpoints from world.targets each tick. When null the brain runs the original open-loop FlightPlan logic.

nodes.label: Open-loop vs Closed-loop control duality
nodes.rationale: Two control modes coexist in tickShuttle: open-loop (pre-baked FlightPlan, counter-based phase transitions) and closed-loop (setpoints re-derived per tick from world.targets, phase inferred from geometry). The grounded phase is not handled in tick — it needs wrapper closures for pickTarget/planFn.

nodes.label: Float64Array parallel arrays for trail (cache-locality pattern)
nodes.rationale: Stores trail points as parallel Float64Arrays instead of array-of-objects to cut per-point allocation and improve cache locality during the per-frame draw walk.
nodes.norm_label: float64array parallel arrays for trail (cache-locality pattern)

nodes.label: District (contiguous arc around planet)
nodes.rationale: Districts form contiguous arcs with center (peak density/height) blending to edges. Height/density follows a bell curve centred on the district midpoint.

nodes.label: Performance targets (≤4ms mean, ≤8ms p95, 0% >16ms)
nodes.rationale: The rendering loop targets ≤4ms mean JS/frame and ≤8ms p95 during autopan, with 0% frames above 16ms. Dominant costs: Pixi render pipeline ~2ms, actor layout ~0.5ms, engine trail draw.

nodes.label: Static-world guard pattern
nodes.rationale: Slice and overlay layout is skipped entirely when xDeg, cameraY, and zoom are unchanged. layer.layout() must not be called outside this guard.

nodes.label: CodeScene 10.0 code health requirement
nodes.rationale: All new/modified code must score 10.0 on CodeScene code health before a task is marked done.
